description:
You are the LMS administrator at State University. The Engineering department is starting a new cohort of students who need automatic enrollment in their required courses.

1. Create a site-wide cohort called 'Engineering Program Cohort 2024' with the cohort ID 'eng2024'.

2. Add exactly these 5 students to the cohort: eng_alice, eng_bob, eng_carol, eng_dave, eng_emma.

3. Set up cohort synchronization enrollment for CS110 (Computer Science Fundamentals): configure it so all members of 'Engineering Program Cohort 2024' are automatically enrolled in CS110 with the Student role.

4. Set up cohort synchronization enrollment for ENG110 (Introduction to Engineering): configure it so all members of 'Engineering Program Cohort 2024' are automatically enrolled in ENG110 with the Student role.

5. Verify that all 5 cohort members are now enrolled in both CS110 and ENG110 as students.

Login: admin / Admin1234!
